fix(transforms)!: avoid projecting window-only columns in eliminate_qualify [WORKBUDDY] (#8447)

* fix(transforms): avoid projecting window-only columns in eliminate_qualify

eliminate_qualify moved each window function of a QUALIFY clause into a
subquery, but it also projected every column found inside the window. The
window already computes those columns, so the extra projections are
redundant and break the query when it is grouped (the column is selected
ungrouped) or when the window contains a subquery (the column's table is
not in scope).

It also replaced a column by the select alias sharing its name without
checking the column's qualifier, so x.s next to SUM(x.s) AS s turned into
SUM(SUM(x.s)).

Fixes #8446
